title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Premenstrual Syndrome
intro: Herbal creams for Premenstrual syndrome are topical creams or ointments made from a combination of herbs, essential oils, and other natural ingredients designed to alleviate the symptoms associated with Premenstrual syndrome (PMS). These creams work by providing relief from physical and emotional symptoms such as cramps, bloating, mood swings, and fatigue. Some examples of herbal creams used to treat PMS include Dong quai creams, which help to regulate menstrual cycles, Ginger creams, which reduce inflammation and ease cramps, and Peppermint creams, which ease digestive issues and reduce stress. Other examples include Wild yam creams, which reduce anxiety and promote relaxation, and Chamomile creams, which soothe and calm the mind and body, making them a popular choice for women experiencing PMS.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia creams have been traditionally used to alleviate symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (PMS), a common condition affecting women of reproductive age. The calming and soothing properties of these creams help to reduce anxiety and stress associated with PMS, promoting relaxation and comfort. The bioactive constituents, including linalool and linalyl acetate, in Lavandula angustifolia creams exert their therapeutic effects by modulating the body's hormone balance and regulating the menstrual cycle. By using Lavandula angustifolia creams, women can experience relief from PMS symptoms, such as bloating, mood swings, and breast tenderness, leading to improved overall well-being and quality of life.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Disease-a-month : DM", Lavandula angustifolia creams may improve premenstrual syndrome, but more study is needed for conclusive evidence.

By promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels, Melissa officinalis creams help to alleviate PMS symptoms, allowing women to feel more balanced and composed during this time. The benefits of using Melissa officinalis creams to treat PMS include improved mood, reduced anxiety, and enhanced overall well-being.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Disease-a-month : DM", Melissa officinalis creams may help improve premenstrual syndrome, but more study is needed to confirm its efficacy.

preparations.preparation_desc: Angelica archangelica creams have been traditionally used to treat the premenstrual syndrome (PMS) ailment, primarily due to their anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. Echinacea purpurea creams have gained popularity as a natural remedy to alleviate symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (PMS). These creams contain bioactive constituents such as alkylamides and caffeic acid, which have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce symptoms of PMS, including bloating, mood swings, and breast tenderness. The anti-inflammatory properties of Echinacea purpurea creams also help to reduce prostaglandins, which are hormone-like substances that cause uterine contractions and contribute to PMS symptoms. By using Echinacea purpurea creams, women can experience relief from PMS symptoms, improved mood, and reduced discomfort, making it a beneficial herbal preparation for treating this common ailment.
